count-distinct:
: main
  (forall ρ; ρ xs:Seq Int^many -- ρ count:Int^many)
  locals { xs } {
    prim seq-int.empty
    0
    [ xs prim seq-int.len ]
    [ locals { seen i } {
      i xs prim seq-int.at
      0 false
      [ seen prim seq-int.len ]
      [ locals { val found j } {
        found
        [ j seen prim seq-int.at val prim =
          [ true ]
          [ [ 1 prim + ] dip ]
          if
        ]
        [ false ]
        if
        [ 1 prim + ] dip
      } ]
      call
      [ seen val prim seq-int.push ]
      dip
      [ 1 prim + ] dip
    } ]
    call
    prim seq-int.len
  };
primes-up-to:
: main
  (forall ρ; ρ n:Int^many -- ρ primes:Seq Int^many)
  locals { n } {
    prim seq-int.empty
    2
    [ n ]
    [ locals { primes p } {
      primes
      0 true
      [ primes prim seq-int.len ]
      [ locals { is_prime i } {
        is_prime
        [ i primes prim seq-int.at p prim mod 0 prim = ]
        [ false ]
        if
        [ 1 prim + ] dip
      } ]
      call
      [ primes p prim seq-int.push ]
      dip
      [ 1 prim + ] dip
    } ]
    call
  };
